findings.statement: The parameter-free upstream-speed transit scale outperforms the orientation correction in every reserved configuration.

reliability.rationale: The retained evidence supports the stated narrow conclusion under Configuration→particle category→trajectory averaging; 76 reserved trajectories across 3 configurations; upstream-only native windows. Strong adverse evidence: Two-dimensional orientation, ambiguous thickness/fluid metadata and absent normal stress block a unique drag mechanism. Constant-speed success does not prove unchanged drag.
